title: Story premise EDU010: The Unpaired Umbrella
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (basic math). Hook: Must every umbrella belong to a full group? Takeaway/theme: Division can produce complete groups and a remainder.
description: A coat-check robot must place seventeen umbrellas into groups of four, but keeps waiting for a fifth full group. Four groups fill, one umbrella remains, and a remainder shelf completes the count honestly.
